screens.name: Onboarding & Language Setup Wizard
screens.description: 5-step glassmorphic setup wizard featuring 15 regional/international language selection, unrestricted live camera feed, Google Workspace authorization, medical document OCR upload, and emergency contacts.

screens.name: 7-Inch Touchscreen Home Dashboard
screens.description: Clean eldercare home interface with live dynamic island status, actual activity logs, real-time vitals summary, 5 health widgets (Sleep, Hydration, Activity, Mood, AI status), speed-dial contacts, and draggable control widget.

screens.name: Health Vitals & AI Diagnostics
screens.description: Real patient measurements with live Gemini AI clinical reasoning engine, emergency fall detection triggers, and Google Sheets synchronization.

screens.name: Medication Desk & Dispenser Inventory
screens.description: Today's timeline interactive medication schedule, pill shapes and colors, low inventory warning banners, and 20-slot cartridge inventory grid with physical refill triggers.

screens.name: Google Calendar Monthly Grid View
screens.description: 7-column interactive monthly grid view for doctor checkups and care appointments synchronized live with Google Calendar API.

screens.name: Google Chat Family Eldercare Space
screens.description: Real Google Chat webhook integration allowing family members and caregivers to exchange messages directly in the care circle space.

screens.name: Google Meet Video Calling & SOS Emergency
screens.description: Google Meet video call space creation, prominent red SOS Emergency quick dial, call history log, and senior speed dial for direct doctor and family connections.

screens.name: Music & Audio (Deezer API)
screens.description: Spotify-style music streaming interface powered by the official Deezer OAuth & search API, featuring top albums, playlists, audio player, and search.

screens.name: Videos Hub (Invidious API)
screens.description: Clean video streaming interface built with the Invidious decentralized Youtube API proxy for direct unencrypted video/audio streaming.

screens.name: Live News Hub (NewsData API)
screens.description: Real-time news feed using NewsData.io query endpoints with error-handling, category tabs, search, and article summaries.

screens.name: Senior Brain Fitness & Fine Motor Games Suite
screens.description: Comprehensive suite with 15 Cognitive & Memory games, 10 Fine Motor Dexterity games, 10 Low-Impact Physical/Mobility games, and 15 Social Language games.

screens.name: Reading & Books Hub (Google Books API)
screens.description: Search millions of books, read descriptions, view real covers, and open Google Books directly.

screens.name: Avenly Companion Brain & Voice Assistant
screens.description: Powered by Gemini with soothing Web Speech synthesis voice engine, floating dynamic island animations, keyboard input mode, message history log, and Google Sheets schedule derivation.

screens.name: Settings & Device Status
screens.description: 13 comprehensive settings categories, standby lock screen configuration, live user profile settings, Google Workspace connection status, and test fall trigger diagnostic.
